files.content: equal to the bytes of manifest chunk 1 (fixed point, see note)

construction.note: The manifest exceeds 24575 bytes, so it has 2 canonical chunks. /a-shared.txt sorts first, so its entry lies wholly in chunk 0; chunk 1 holds only filler entries. Its size field is a 2-byte integer for any length 256..65535, so the manifest length does not depend on the chosen content. Build once with placeholder content of the right length, take chunk 1, rebuild with that content; chunk 1 is unchanged, so the fixed point holds.

constructed.derivation: references = 2 manifest chunks + 1 (/a-shared.txt) + 1 (/index.html) + 100 fillers. Keys: manifest chunk 0, manifest chunk 1 (= /a-shared.txt chunk), HTML, 'a'.

The cache key includes the length (FD:L1309), so (A,112) misses the entry (A,111) and is requested; the returned code has length 112, not 113, so fetch.length. An address-only cache would make 1 request and report the same rule; the request count discriminates.
